limitations: Real iPhone/iPad and native Windows Chrome/Mac Safari cases are distinct from Playwright engine tests.

The earlier Windows Chromium 153 cross-network attempt stayed checking. Branded Windows Chrome 155 later passed public cross-network pairing/1 MiB transfer/export; no root cause for the earlier attempt is claimed.
Windows Chromium 153 same-host control passed 1 MiB pairing/transfer/export; it has no cross-network scope.
Cloud macOS Playwright WebKit 26.6 failed its usable OPFS gate. Native Mac Safari 26.4 separately passed public 1 MiB pairing/receive/export.
iPad and native desktop cloud cases are small-file receiving scenarios. Reverse roles, larger sizes, recovery, native picker/share UI and installation were not certified for those platforms.
No universal Android-tablet, PC model, router, carrier or mobile file-size claim.
